b141522477ac18cc.description: About the Role / Project scope The Analyst/Specialist – Feasibilities will support the Feasibilities function by helping establish and manage a dedicated PMO and analytical capability across strategic initiatives and business workstreams. The role will focus on execution tracking, stakeholder coordination, governance support, committee management, and follow-up on management decisions to ensure effective delivery and alignment across functions. This role will play a key part in supporting workstream committees and PCG aggregation activities, enabling structured governance, timely reporting, and execution control so that leadership can focus on strategic oversight and key decision-making. Key Responsibilities · Support the establishment and ongoing management of PMO frameworks within the Feasibilities function. · Coordinate with multiple stakeholders across functions to track progress on strategic initiatives and key deliverables. · Prepare high-quality management presentations, dashboards, reports, and executive materials for leadership and committee discussions. · Act as secretariat support for committees by managing agendas, meeting minutes, action trackers, and follow-up activities. · Monitor execution of management decisions and ensure timely closure of agreed action items. · Support aggregation and consolidation of PCG/workstream updates, risks, dependencies, and key milestones. · Assist in tracking KPIs, budgets, timelines, and overall project performance across strategic initiatives. · Conduct business analysis and prepare actionable insights to support planning, decision-making, and performance management. · Ensure proper documentation, and structured communication across stakeholders. · Handle multiple workstreams with support simultaneously while maintaining strong attention to detail and delivery timelines. Skills and Attributes required/ desired · Strong multitasking and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. · Advanced Microsoft PowerPoint skills with the ability to create executive-level presentations and storytelling materials. · Advanced Microsoft Excel skills including data analysis, dashboards, reporting, formulas, pivot tables, and tracking mechanisms. · Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities. · Excellent communication and stakeholder coordination skills. · High attention to detail, follow-through, and ownership mindset. · Ability to work independently while coordinating across multiple teams and senior stakeholders. · Strong time management and execution discipline. Preferred Background and experience Preferably Saudi national and female candidate. Bachelor’s degree in: Business Administration Finance Economics Accounting Management Information Systems Industrial Engineering or related field · MBA or PMO/project management certifications would be an added advantage.

b1ee3ea8252500b7.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة جزيرة سماء للازياء عن بائع للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تقديم مجموعة من السلع والخدمات للعملاء، وتوفير معلومات دقيقة حول المنتجات، وإدارة عمليات الدفع والمخزون. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية بيع مجموعة من السلع والخدمات للعملاء. توفير معلومات مفصلة تتعلق بالمنتجات، بما في ذلك الاستخدامات والأسعار. مراقبة مستويات المخزون وضمان ترتيب المتجر بشكل مستمر. إصدار طلبات شراء المنتجات الجديدة والتعامل مع المنتجات الواردة. تولي أمور الدفع وتلقي المدفوعات من العملاء. معالجة طلبات استبدال المنتجات والمرتجعات وفقاً للسياسات المتبعة في الشركة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات أو خدمة العملاء. القدرة على التعامل مع العملاء وتقديم خدمة ممتازة. مهارات تواصل جيدة ولباقة في التعامل. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقع في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. يتطلب العمل التفاعل المباشر مع العملاء وإدارة المهام اليومية المتعلقة بالمبيعات والمخزون في بيئة متجر ديناميكية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

b13cde45fb2ec697.description: About KBR and the Role KBR, Inc. is seeking a Planner to join its team in Al Jubail, Eastern region. KBR Sustainable Technology Solutions (STS) delivers comprehensive solutions across the entire asset lifecycle, including licensed process technologies, advisory services, technical expertise, energy transition solutions, and design capabilities. This full-time role involves developing and managing maintenance plans for various operational activities. Role Overview The Planner will be responsible for preparing and developing preventive, corrective, and predictive maintenance plans on a weekly and monthly basis. These plans will cover mechanical, electrical, instrument, and general services maintenance activities, ensuring operational efficiency and compliance with safety standards. Key Responsibilities Prepare weekly and monthly routine and preventive maintenance plans, including all related activities. Ensure proper resource planning and sourcing for the implementation and completion of planned maintenance activities according to schedule. Analyze and record critical operational and maintenance issues related to SATORP’s equipment, plants, and utilities availability. Liaise and participate in various meetings and analyses with other Divisions regarding the development of maintenance plans and schedules, providing technical inputs and recommendations as required. Coordinate with the CET Division to evaluate progress against plans and conduct technical studies to identify and recommend new practices for developing planning and implementation activities. Coordinate with all applicable stakeholders to ensure that maintenance personnel, materials, spare parts, tools, and equipment are available and ready to perform jobs. Prepare and maintain statistical maintenance and technical reports relating to routine and preventive maintenance activities at SATORP. Utilize SAP systems, computer programs, and software to ensure effective implementation of routine and preventive maintenance plans. Assist in preparing, developing, and measuring Contractor’s Key Performance Indicators. Maintain all historical records and databases of routine and preventive maintenance plans. Ensure compliance with all HSE rules and encourage reporting of unsafe acts and conditions. Comply with all SHE procedures prior to commencement and during work. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5-10 years of experience in a relevant planning role. Strong technical understanding of maintenance jobs. Well-organized and proactive with excellent communication skills. Proven leadership skills within large organizations. Maturity of judgment under pressure and ability to resolve problems effectively. Strategic management skills. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Al Jubail, Saudi Arabia, within a dynamic environment focused on sustainable technology solutions and asset lifecycle management.

b1518ca07a613e0a.description: About the Role Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a Senior Specialist - Accounts to join their team in Riyadh, Riyadh Province. This full-time role involves performing and overseeing complex accounting activities to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of financial records and transactions. The Senior Specialist will provide technical accounting expertise, support financial reporting processes, and contribute to the effective operation of accounting functions through analysis, reconciliations, controls, and continuous improvement initiatives. Key Responsibilities Perform and review complex accounting transactions, journal entries, accruals, adjustments, and reconciliations. Maintain and monitor general ledger accounts to ensure accuracy and compliance with accounting standards and internal policies. Prepare and review monthly, quarterly, and annual account reconciliations and supporting schedules. Support financial closing activities and ensure timely completion of month-end and year-end processes. Assist in the preparation of financial statements, management reports, and regulatory reporting requirements. Analyze accounting data, investigate variances, and recommend corrective actions where necessary. Ensure compliance with IFRS, corporate accounting policies, internal controls, and governance requirements. Support internal and external audit activities by preparing documentation, responding to audit inquiries, and implementing recommendations. Coordinate with Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Treasury, Procurement, and business functions to resolve accounting-related matters. Review financial transactions for accuracy, completeness, and appropriate accounting treatment. Contribute to process improvements, system enhancements, and automation initiatives within the accounting function. Provide technical guidance and support to junior accounting team members as required. Experience and Qualifications Candidates for this role should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in accounting. The role requires a strong understanding of accounting standards and regulatory requirements to ensure the integrity of financial records. Internal Interactions Accounting Team Finance and Reporting Teams Treasury Team Accounts Payable Team Accounts Receivable Team Procurement Team Internal Audit Business Unit Representatives External Interactions External Auditors Banks and Financial Institutions Regulatory Authorities Tax Advisors Vendors and Service Providers Application Process Further details regarding the application process and salary will be provided to qualified candidates.

b15bc2ebe15b4dc2.description: About SYSTRA SYSTRA is a global engineering and consultancy group specializing in public transport and sustainable mobility. With over 10,300 employees, SYSTRA designs safe and sustainable transport solutions globally, facilitating social inclusion and access to employment, education, and leisure. For 65 years, the Group has supported cities and regions in developing, improving, and modernizing their infrastructure and transport systems across the project lifecycle, from design to deployment and maintenance. Operating in over 80 countries, SYSTRA generates 74% of its turnover internationally and supports clients in their digital, ecological, and energy transitions. Role Overview: Architect Lead (Retail and Advertising) SYSTRA is seeking an Architect Lead specializing in Retail and Advertising to join the team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves assisting a client with commercial strategies related to retail areas and various advertising elements, specifically as part of an extension to the Riyadh Metro project. The position requires a professional with over 10 years of experience in relevant fields. Key Responsibilities Provide commercial consultancy services for non-exhaustive items including retail areas, all types of internal and external advertisement, "click and collect" services, and ATMs. Review the design of retail areas to ensure compliance with contract requirements, confirm the availability of properly sized connections for rental, and verify that retail areas are fit for purpose. Review the project's advertisement scheme, ensuring appropriate advertisement elements are utilized and their distribution is optimized. Support the client in performing spatial planning, design review, and layout optimization for all retail zones and advertising spaces. Act as the primary interface with the client for all matters related to retail and advertising elements. Required Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of professional experience in a relevant field. Demonstrated ability in stakeholder management and commercial negotiation. Proven experience in technical report writing. Strong cross-disciplinary coordination skills, particularly in managing interfaces between tenant fit-outs and core building infrastructure (MEP, structural, and ICT). Location and Work Type This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role involves working directly with the client on-site as part of the Riyadh Metro extension project.

b1894ad19756690e.job_title: Medical Science Liaison Rare Disease META+
b1894ad19756690e.description: About AstraZeneca and the Role AstraZeneca is expanding its presence in rare diseases following the acquisition of Alexion in 2021. Rare diseases represent a high-growth therapeutic area with ongoing innovation and significant unmet medical needs. This full-time position for a Medical Science Liaison - Rare Disease META+ is based in Jeddah, Western Region, KSA, and requires 2-5 years of experience. Role Overview The Medical Science Liaison (MSL) for Rare Disease plays a role in integrating scientific capabilities to introduce new therapies in rare disease settings into clinical practice. This position is part of the Medical Affairs team and reports to the Medical Manager Rare Disease. The MSL provides medical and scientific support to healthcare professionals (HCPs) regarding the use of medicines within AstraZeneca's rare disease portfolio. Key Responsibilities Identify and cultivate relationships with HCPs, including physicians, nurse practitioners, registered nurses, pharmacists, and patient advocacy groups. Conduct educational programs on disease states and the appropriate use of medicines, aligned with Medical Affairs plans. Respond to customer inquiries by providing focused clinical and scientific information. Deliver clinical and scientific information to support appropriate medicine use in a patient-focused manner. Maintain expertise in disease state management and stay informed on emerging therapies and the therapeutic landscape. Gather customer insights regarding medicine use to inform medical and commercial strategies, adhering to internal standards and regulatory requirements. Provide internal stakeholders with insights into the local medical community, clinical practice trends, HCP insights, and perceived gaps in scientific knowledge. Share emerging data with HCPs in a scientific, objective, and balanced manner. Identify and develop scientifically based relationships with Key External Experts (KEEs) in the Saudi Arabia market. Collaborate with HCPs on scientific activities such as clinical trials, Non-Interventional Studies, Investigator Sponsored Studies (ISSs), and scientific exchange. Identify and train speakers for local events and provide recommendations for advisory board participants. Present scientific data to HCPs in both group and one-on-one settings. Facilitate continuing medical education events for HCPs. Provide actionable insights to internal stakeholders to enhance the value and appropriate use of AstraZeneca products. Engage in strategic planning meetings with payer customers or hospital decision-makers, ensuring separation of scientific topics from promotional discussions. Demonstrate and continuously update expertise in AstraZeneca products, emerging therapies, competitors, patient and treatment trends, clinical trials, and scientific activities within the disease area. Support the Medical Manager and Marketing Team in developing non-promotional and promotional materials/programs. Provide scientific support at AstraZeneca-sponsored educational events. Gather, monitor, and share competitor knowledge. Plan and execute regional medical activities during product launch processes. Serve as a medical resource for sales representatives, answering medical questions to support their use of approved materials and understanding of the therapeutic area. Participate in, develop, and conduct therapeutic area and product trainings for internal customers. Respond to unsolicited requests for information about unapproved products or uses, presenting information objectively and factually. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Medicine, Pharmacy, or Pharmacology. 3 or more years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry or equivalent. Experience in rare disease or oncology therapeutic areas is an advantage. Demonstrated expertise in synthesizing scientific information and communicating it effectively to HCPs. Direct patient care experience or equivalent experience in the pharmaceutical industry. Required Skills Excellent ability to learn and grasp scientific concepts and knowledge. Strong presentation skills for communicating medical data and concepts. Proficiency in computer skills (Excel, Word, PowerPoint). Excellent project management capabilities. Strong oral and written communication and interpersonal skills. Leadership capabilities with the ability to work independently.

b1fbcbcfdda866cd.description: المهام الوظيفية استقبال العملاء والترحيب بهم بأسلوب لبق وودود، وفهم احتياجاتهم وتفضيلاتهم. الإلمام الكامل بالمنتجات والخدمات المقدمة، وشرحها للعملاء بشكل واضح وتقديم الاقتراحات المناسبة. عرض المنتجات والخدمات، والإجابة على استفسارات العملاء، ومساعدتهم خلال عملية الشراء بما يساهم في تحقيق أهداف المبيعات. تنظيم المنتجات ومتابعة توفرها على الأرفف والتأكد من ترتيبها بشكل مناسب. المساهمة في تحسين مظهر المعرض وترتيب المنتجات بما يعزز تجربة التسوق لدى العملاء. إتمام عمليات البيع بدقة وفق الإجراءات والسياسات المعتمدة، بما في ذلك التعامل مع النقد. جمع ملاحظات وآراء العملاء ونقلها إلى الإدارة للمساهمة في تحسين المنتجات والخدمات وتجربة العميل. المحافظة على مستوى عالٍ من رضا العملاء وتقديم تجربة خدمة متميزة. العمل ضمن فريق بروح تعاونية والمساهمة في تحقيق أهداف المعرض. المؤهلات المطلوبة شهادة الثانوية العامة كحد أدنى، ويفضل وجود تدريب أو مؤهل إضافي في مجال المبيعات أو خدمة العملاء. خبرة سابقة في مجال خدمة العملاء أو المبيعات أو في مجال ذي صلة. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل والتعامل مع العملاء. شخصية ودودة ولبقة، مع التركيز على رضا العملاء وجودة الخدمة. القدرة على استخدام الحاسب الآلي والأنظمة الأساسية لإتمام عمليات البيع. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق والتعاون مع الزملاء. الاستعداد للعمل بساعات مرنة تشمل الفترات المسائية وعطلات نهاية الأسبوع.

b11ee8be34980a9d.description: About the Role Emerson is seeking a Field Service/STO Manager to join their team in Al Jubail, Eastern Region. This full-time role focuses on leading the planning, execution, and continuous improvement of Shutdown, Turnaround, and Outage (STO) projects, as well as field service activities related to control valves, isolation valves, and pneumatic, hydraulic, and electric actuators. Role Responsibilities The Field Service/STO Manager will be responsible for driving operational excellence, customer satisfaction, safety performance, team development, and business growth. Key responsibilities include: Leading the planning, coordination, and execution of STO projects, valve overhauls, commissioning, troubleshooting, calibration, upgrades, and related field service activities. Ensuring safe, on-time, and high-quality project delivery while meeting customer expectations, operational objectives, and financial targets. Managing workforce planning, resource allocation, subcontractor coordination, scheduling, and service execution to ensure efficient project delivery. Developing and coaching field service engineers and technicians through mentoring, training, knowledge sharing, and performance development initiatives. Collaborating with sales, business development, and lifecycle services teams to identify customer opportunities, support quotations, and expand STO and service-related business growth. Monitoring key performance indicators related to safety, quality, customer satisfaction, delivery performance, and project profitability. Promoting a strong safety culture by ensuring compliance with company policies, industry standards, and customer requirements. Leading continuous improvement initiatives that enhance operational efficiency, service delivery, and customer outcomes. The role requires individuals who demonstrate the following attributes: Ability to build strong partnerships and work collaboratively across teams to achieve shared goals. Consistent delivery of results, even in challenging situations, by effectively balancing operational priorities, customer expectations, and business objectives. Proficiency in developing and empowering people through coaching, feedback, and opportunities for growth, creating an environment where individuals can perform effectively. Capacity to make sound and timely decisions based on analysis, experience, and business needs. Adaptability to changing priorities and evolving customer requirements. This platform is designed to be user-friendly, facilitating the conversion of insights into action and supporting a culture of creativity and continuous improvement. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and requires 5-10 years of experience. You will collaborate with a customer-focused team, developing customized solutions to help clients achieve their business objectives. Key Responsibilities Establish successful relationships with enterprise clients across Saudi Arabia, delivering technical and business value in collaboration with Account Executives. Serve as an expert in big data analytics, guiding customers on architecture, design, and implementation to ensure successful adoption of the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform. b11761023c82d9af.description: About EXP EXP Arabia is a multidisciplinary engineering design and supervisory consultant with over 100 years of experience globally. Operating from North America and other regions, EXP provides engineering, architecture, design, and consulting services for built and natural environments. The firm emphasizes building strong relationships and fostering a culture of creativity and entrepreneurial spirit, with a mission to understand, innovate, partner, and deliver sustainable solutions. The Opportunity EXP Arabia is seeking a Senior Mechanical Designer, Mining to join its collaborative Mining team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves working alongside multidisciplinary professionals to deliver practical and innovative solutions for complex mining projects. Key Responsibilities Serve as a working lead for a project team of designers within a multidisciplinary environment. Produce mechanical layouts and plant designs for mining projects using Microstation V8, E3D, AutoCAD, and other 2-D and 3-D tools. Extract drawings from 3-D models. Provide support for systems and tools, including the Bentley Suite of software (OpenPlant Modeler, OpenPlant P&ID). Communicate positively and effectively within the team. Provide regular progress feedback to the Overall Mechanical Engineering Lead regarding deliverables. Technical college graduate in Mechanical Engineering with experience in mining, mineral, or similar industries. Active member of the Saudi Council of Engineers. Design experience, preferably in the consulting industry, with a preference for candidates experienced in Mineral Mining projects. Minimum of 4 years of experience with Bentley, OpenPlant, or 3D Microstation. Sound understanding of design principles, Saudi engineering codes, and technical standards. Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project), CAD, and BIM tools. Knowledge of mining-related processes. Professional Attributes Demonstrated professionalism in written and verbal communication. Professional presentation, both internally and externally (*, attire, engagement, meeting preparation). Ability to deliver technical presentations and white papers. Positive contribution to EXP and local office culture. b154c496a90b7adb.description: About the Role InterContinental Hotels & Resorts is seeking a Hostess for a full-time position in Umluj. The Hostess plays a crucial role in creating a welcoming first impression for guests by delivering professional, courteous, and personalized service. This position involves managing guest flow, handling reservations, and ensuring that every guest experience aligns with the luxury service standards of InterContinental Hotels & Resorts and IHG. Key Responsibilities Warmly and professionally welcome and greet all guests upon arrival, using the restaurant name and guest names when possible. Ensure the restaurant entrance, hostess station, tables, and surrounding areas are clean, organized, and prepared before opening. Verify guest reservations and booking details using the reservation system or book. Manage restaurant reservations, including telephone bookings, walk-ins, special requests, and guest dining preferences. Escort guests to their assigned or preferred tables and present menus according to service standards. Coordinate guest seating arrangements and table allocation with the restaurant service team to ensure smooth operations. Provide accurate waiting times and manage guest flow during peak periods. Maintain detailed knowledge of the restaurant menu, beverages, daily specials, promotions, and hotel facilities. Respond promptly and courteously to guest inquiries, requests, and complaints, ensuring appropriate follow-up and service recovery. Recognize VIP guests, repeat guests, and special occasions, providing personalized service and attention to detail. Coordinate with the Restaurant Manager, service team, and Culinary team to communicate guest preferences, dietary requirements, and special requests. Maintain the cleanliness and proper presentation of menus, beverage lists, reservation materials, and the hostess station. Assist with food and beverage service as required to support smooth restaurant operations. Maintain accurate guest reservation records and update relevant guest information in the designated system. Promote restaurant offerings and special promotions where appropriate to enhance the guest experience and support revenue generation. Maintain professional grooming, personal hygiene, and uniform standards in accordance with IHG policies. Attend departmental briefings, meetings, and training sessions as required. Follow all hotel policies, procedures, brand standards, and applicable food safety and hygiene requirements. Demonstrate awareness of occupational health and safety procedures, fire and emergency protocols, and security requirements. Perform any other reasonable duties assigned by the Restaurant Manager or Food & Beverage Management. Qualifications and Experience Previous experience in a similar position within a hotel or luxury restaurant is preferred. A Diploma or certificate in Hospitality Management or a related field is an advantage. Required Skills Good communication and interpersonal skills. Good command of English; additional languages are an advantage. Knowledge of restaurant reservation systems and basic computer applications. Strong guest service, organizational, and problem-solving skills. Ability to work under pressure and maintain a professional attitude.

b126ed5187e778b3.description: About SYSTRA SYSTRA is a global engineering and consultancy group specializing in public transport and sustainable mobility. With over 10,300 employees, SYSTRA focuses on designing safe and sustainable transport solutions to connect people and facilitate access to employment, education, and leisure worldwide. For 65 years, the Group has supported cities and regions in developing, improving, and modernizing infrastructure and transport systems across project lifecycles, from design to maintenance. SYSTRA operates in over 80 countries, with 74% of its turnover generated internationally, and supports clients in their digital, ecological, and energy transitions. The Role of RAMS Lead SYSTRA is seeking an experienced RAMS Lead to join its rail infrastructure team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time leadership position involves overseeing the Reliability, Availability, Maintainability, and Safety (RAMS) function for rail operations and projects. The RAMS Lead will be responsible for developing and implementing comprehensive RAMS strategies to ensure optimal system performance, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence across all rail assets and initiatives. Key Responsibilities Lead the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of RAMS strategies and programs in alignment with organizational objectives and industry standards. Conduct and oversee Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), Fault Tree Analysis (FTA), and other reliability assessments to identify risks and mitigation strategies. Manage RAMS data collection, analysis, and reporting to support evidence-based decision-making and performance optimization. Establish and maintain RAMS performance metrics, KPIs, and dashboards to track system reliability, availability, and safety across rail operations. Collaborate with engineering, operations, and maintenance teams to develop maintenance strategies, spare parts optimization, and asset lifecycle management plans. Ensure compliance with international rail safety standards, regulations, and industry best practices (ISO 26262, EN 50126, and equivalent standards). Lead cross-functional teams and provide technical guidance on RAMS-related issues, design reviews, and system improvements. Develop and deliver RAMS training programs to enhance organizational capability and awareness. Prepare comprehensive RAMS documentation, technical reports, and presentations for stakeholders and regulatory bodies. Mentor junior engineers and contribute to building a high-performing RAMS team. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 15 years of experience in a relevant field. Demonstrated experience in leading RAMS functions within rail infrastructure or similar complex systems. Proficiency in reliability assessment techniques such as FMEA and FTA. Strong understanding of international rail safety standards and regulations (*, ISO 26262, EN 50126). Ability to collaborate effectively with diverse engineering, operations, and maintenance teams. Excellent communication skills for preparing technical reports, documentation, and presentations. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within SYSTRA's rail infrastructure team. The role involves working in a dynamic environment focused on sustainable transport solutions.

b13753fad5a94012.description: About Trigo TRIGO is a global leader in inspection, quality management, and operational excellence solutions. The company serves demanding industries such as automotive, aerospace, and high-tech sectors. Operating in 28 countries across four continents, TRIGO supports clients in continuously improving their industrial performance through recognized expertise, proven methods, and dedicated teams. The Role of Metrology / CMM Programmer TRIGO is seeking Metrology / CMM Programmers to join its team in Makkah, specifically covering Jeddah and Makkah cities. This full-time role involves developing and maintaining dimensional measurement programs and supporting various inspection activities. Candidates should possess 3-5 years of experience in a relevant field. b1a63f9db3765ce5.job_title: Senior Product Manager - Catalog and Store
b1a63f9db3765ce5.description: At Salla, we are building the digital backbone of commerce in the region, for thousands of merchants starting, growing and scaling their businesses. Catalog is the layer underneath everything: storefronts, search, recommendations and every channel a merchant sells through read from the same product data. This role owns both sides of that line, the catalog merchants build and the store their buyers shop. Salla does not build the catalog. Merchants do, and often not even the merchant: a freelancer, operations staff, an agency. The buyer never sees the catalog, only whether they can find the product, trust the page and get what they ordered. Your job is to change what people who do not work for you produce, and turn that data into a store that converts. You lead four product managers across Catalog and Store, and you carry the numbers. Areas of impact: product data input, structure and meaning, AI enrichment, store experience and search, and how the data performs downstream. Responsibilities: Set the strategy for Catalog and Store as one system, so a new category or way of selling is a configuration, not a rebuild. Own how product data is created and improved, and define quality by how the data performs downstream, not by how many fields are filled. Own the buyer's path from search to purchase: search relevance, the product page and availability. Design for the people who actually enter the data, including those who do not own the store, so the good path is the fastest one. Put AI to work where it earns trust: decide what we generate, what we suggest and what we never touch, and learn from every correction. Use AI to take merchants from a blank store to a well-designed, ready-to-sell storefront. Validate every bet against the outcome it promised: experiment where traffic allows, measure where it does not, and stop what does not work. Decide how much structure to impose and where merchants stay free, including for external channels with strict requirements. Lead four product managers, two on Catalog and two on Store: give them real ownership, coach their craft and raise the bar of what the group ships. Six or more years in product management, including a self-serve platform where users created their own data and you owned its quality. A number you moved by changing what users produced at the moment of entry, not by cleaning it up afterwards. Hands-on ownership of a buyer-facing commerce experience, such as search, discovery or product pages, with conversion you moved and experiments that proved it. AI in production on structured data, with concrete answers on confidence thresholds, error rates and what you did when it was wrong at scale. Fluency in how product data is structured: taxonomies, attributes, variants, identifiers, matching, and external channel requirements. You own outcomes rather than roadmaps, can set a strategy others repeat, and have managed and coached product managers without stepping away from the craft. Full professional fluency in Arabic and English, regional merchant context preferred, and willing to work on-site in Saudi Arabia.

b1232363e2520aaa.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة سما صلاله للمقاولات عن فني هندسة كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في جازان. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تركيب وصيانة الأنظمة الكهربائية المتنوعة، وتقديم الدعم الفني للمهندسين. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تركيب المحركات واللوحات والمولدات والمحولات الكهربائية، والإشراف عليها ومراقبتها. تقديم المساعدة للمهندسين الكهربائيين في تشخيص المشكلات الفنية وحلها. تحديد المخطط وكمية المواد والمعدات واليد العاملة المطلوبة بناءً على المخططات الأولية للمشاريع. توجيه وتنسيق جهود العمال والفنيين والحرفيين الآخرين فيما يتعلق بأعمال التركيب الكهربائي. اختبار الأنظمة بعد تركيبها لضمان مطابقتها للمخطط الأولي والمواصفات المطلوبة. القيام بعمليات الفحص الروتينية ضمن الصيانة الوقائية، وتشخيص الأعطال والتلف المحتمل، واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. التحقق من الأعطال وفحص الأجزاء والمعدات التالفة، وتشخيص المكونات المعطوبة وإصلاحها أو استبدالها. ضمان الاستجابة السريعة لعمليات الطوارئ للتقليل من فترات انقطاع التيار الكهربائي. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية أو مجال ذي صلة. فهم قوي لمبادئ تركيب وصيانة الأنظمة الكهربائية. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات والمواصفات الفنية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في حل المشكلات والتشخيص الفني. القدرة على العمل بفعالية ضمن فريق. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والجودة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في جازان. سيعمل الفني ضمن فريق متخصص في مشاريع المقاولات الكهربائية. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة. نشجع المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة على التقديم.
